editorial:
Imagine living in a giant, fancy villa in Spain with nothing but money and family secrets. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow a rich American guy who finally decides to leave the family nest to move in with his girlfriend. It sounds like a happy ending, but his departure actually kicks off a total disaster for everyone left behind. While he is packing his bags, his brother starts digging into the past and finds out that their mother's death was not an accident at all. The movie blends funny family fights with a tense mystery that keeps you wondering who is actually lying.

You will love how the actors make the family drama feel real, even when things get wild. The plot moves quickly, though some of the middle parts feel a bit slow. If you enjoy movies that start as a comedy and turn into a thriller, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see those beautiful Spanish views. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the colors are just stunning.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the brother discovers that their father actually caused the mother's death during a heated argument. The big twist is that the brother had known for years but stayed silent to keep the family money. In the end, the brother turns the evidence over to the police. The movie wraps up with the father being arrested and the brothers finally cutting ties with their toxic past to start over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family secrets and plot twists.
